The playground accept multiple files so if are importing from other files just include them all at the root level.

items.name: get_chart
items.description: Get historical OHLCV price data (and optionally dividend/split events) for a symbol over a date range.

input.name: events
input.description: Events to include, pipe-separated, e.g. 'div|split'.

input.name: includePrePost
input.description: Whether to include pre/post-market data, default false.

input.name: interval
input.description: Candle interval, default 1d. Intraday intervals only support recent date ranges.

input.name: period1
input.description: Start of the range, e.g. 2024-01-01 or an ISO datetime.

input.name: period2
input.description: End of the range, e.g. 2024-12-31 or an ISO datetime; defaults to now.

input.name: symbol
input.description: Yahoo Finance ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, BTC-USD, EURUSD=X, ^GSPC.

items.name: get_quote
items.description: Get real-time (or near real-time) quote data for one or more symbols, including price, change, OHLC, volume, market cap, 52-week range and more.

input.name: symbols
input.description: One or more ticker symbols to quote, e.g. ['AAPL', 'MSFT'].

items.name: quote_summary
items.description: Get detailed fundamental and financial data for a symbol via Yahoo's quoteSummary modules (profile, financials, statistics, holders, etc.).

input.name: modules
input.description: Modules to include; omit for default (price + summaryDetail). Note: financial-statement modules now return little data — prefer financialData / defaultKeyStatistics.

input.name: symbol
input.description: Yahoo Finance ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, BTC-USD, EURUSD=X, ^GSPC.

items.name: search
items.description: Search for instruments and related news by name, ticker or keyword. Returns matching quotes (symbol, name, exchange, type) and news articles.

input.name: lang
input.description: Language code, e.g. en-US.

input.name: newsCount
input.description: Max number of related news articles to return, default 4.

input.name: query
input.description: Search keyword, e.g. a company name or ticker.

input.name: quotesCount
input.description: Max number of matching instruments to return, default 6.

input.name: region
input.description: Region code, e.g. US.
